# 曼伯歐羅門窗 MBORMC - Custom Mosquito Screens & Pet-Proof Folding Doors

> MBORMC is a global manufacturer specializing in custom mosquito screens, retractable fly screens, pet-proof folding doors, and invisible dust-proof screens. We provide made-to-measure solutions for homes, hotels, apartments, and construction projects, with factory-direct pricing and worldwide shipping from Foshan, China.

Since 2010, we have served clients in over 40 countries, offering both OEM/ODM services and branded products. Our facility is BSCI and ISO9001 certified, ensuring high standards in quality and social responsibility.

## Core Product Lines
All products are available in any size and can be customized to fit your specific requirements.

- [MBORMC® FD01 - Magnetic DIY Screen](https://www.mbormc.com/product-fd01.html): A tool-free, magnetic DIY mosquito screen that attaches securely to metal window frames. Easy installation with strong 3M adhesive mount.

- [MBORMC® H01 - Invisible Retractable Screen](https://www.mbormc.com/product-h01.html): A premium retractable screen for casement windows that rolls up completely when not in use. Available in PET fiber or 304 stainless steel mesh for pet-proof protection.

- [MBORMC® H05 - Pet-Proof Folding Door](https://www.mbormc.com/product-h05.html): A heavy-duty folding screen door designed to withstand daily pet activity. Features a premium aluminum frame and scratch-resistant, high-density mesh.

- [MBORMC® FD04 - Blind + Screen Combo](https://www.mbormc.com/product-fd04.html): A 2-in-1 solution that combines stylish blinds with a mosquito screen, offering adjustable light control and insect protection in one system.
